title: The Price of a Cure
logline: A brilliant doctor has synthesized a cure for a local plague, but it requires harvesting illegal biological samples from quarantined ships, and the local dockmaster is demanding a cut.

roles.description: Will break any law to save a life, deeply cynical about authority.
Controls all access to the quarantine zone and never does a favor for free.
A sealed vessel full of the sick and dying.
The slow, methodical body that insists all cures must undergo ten years of trials.
A hidden asteroid base where illegal biologicals are traded.

public_situation: The {role:medical_board} has declared the recent plague incurable and ordered the infected ships to be locked down until further notice.
private_truth: The doctor has a working cure, but the base compound is classified as highly illegal contraband, forcing them to rely on smugglers to synthesize it.

beats.public_change: The dockmaster tightens security around the quarantined ships, demanding massive bribes for access.

missions.reason: The doctor needs the pilot to shoot the sealed cargo pods off a quarantined freighter to extract the raw biological samples.
missions.private_fact: The freighter's automated defenses will treat this as an attack.

missions.reason: The dockmaster demands the pilot deliver a massive bribe to the smugglers to keep them quiet about the doctor's activities.
missions.private_fact: The dockmaster is pocketing half the bribe.

beats.public_change: The medical board catches wind of the illegal cure and issues arrest warrants.

missions.reason: The doctor desperately needs the pilot to buy the final refinement chemicals from the smugglers to finish the cure.
missions.private_fact: The chemicals are highly volatile and illegal to transport.

beats.public_change: The cure is finished, but the medical board's enforcers have surrounded the doctor's lab.

missions.reason: The doctor asks the pilot to disable the freighter's comms array so they can deliver the cure without the board tracking them.
missions.private_fact: The quarantined patients hail the pilot, offering their remaining hazard pay if the pilot will blow the quarantine locks and let them leave instead of waiting for a cure.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the array and helps distribute the cure.
resolutions.summary: The plague is cured, but the doctor is arrested by the medical board for using untested illegal compounds. The patients survive, but the hero goes to prison.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broke quarantine to smuggle an illegal cure to the dying ships.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the patients' offer and breaks the quarantine locks.
resolutions.summary: The sick scatter across the sector. The disease spreads, the dockmaster is fired for the breach, and the doctor is devastated.

consequences.public_summary: Some pilot cracked the seals on a plague ship for pocket change.

resolutions.summary: Without the cure, the quarantined ships slowly die off. The medical board declares the containment a success.

loose_threads.detail: The biological samples from the plague perfectly match a dormant weaponized virus found in old corporate archives.
The dockmaster's bribe money is paid in sequentially numbered cred-sticks fresh from a central mint.

radio_hooks: {role:medical_board} insists all uncertified plague treatments are highly dangerous.
Desperation grows on {role:quarantined_freighter} as supplies dwindle.

voice_direction.brilliant_doctor: Intense, focused, uses sharp medical terminology.
voice_direction.corrupt_dockmaster: Slow, relaxed, always brings the conversation back to money.
